temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian: he is in some trouble and didn't know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Suspicion confirmed and specified: Jonathan was hiding a serious trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about Jonathan's trouble and decide how to respond.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he doesn't want to drag Christian in, but he accepts that he could use support and resources and needs to find a way out.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan has been hiding that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and expanded: Jonathan's trouble is complicated and serious, and he needs support/resources; he was reluctant to involve Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs Christian's support/resources to get out.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help and support Jonathan, including providing resources to resolve his trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he can't say for sure if it's illegal; he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but he didn't do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs Christian's support/resources to get out.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/expanded: the trouble may involve criminal activity or dangerous/wrong people, though Jonathan claims personal innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan's trouble may involve illegal/criminal elements or wrong people, but Jonathan may be innocent.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up. He tells Jonathan he has leads and will gather evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble may involve illegal/criminal elements or wrong people, but Jonathan may be innocent.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Jonathan is not the perpetrator but is being framed; an external person is responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and evidence is needed to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather more evidence and clear Jonathan's name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian has found out the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan, someone they both know and trust. He tells Jonathan he will confront them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and evidence is needed to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/specified: the framer is someone close and trusted by both Christian and Jonathan; this is a betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both Christian and Jonathan is behind the frame-up and must be brought to justice.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
